recipe: Use an index signature to type objects with arbitrary string keys mapping to a consistent value type, such as a user ID to follower count mapping.
trigger_condition: When you need to type an object where keys are arbitrary strings and all values share the same type.
evidence: This turns out to be exactly the scenario for TypeScript index signatures!

recipe: You can inline index signatures directly within a larger object type declaration instead of extracting them into a separate named type.
trigger_condition: When typing a nested object that contains a mapping of arbitrary keys to values.
evidence: Or, we could always inline everything (this works just fine with index signatures)
